title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: an App pair row declared for a package that still ships the name is never served at a bundle addition's address (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D75mRNRrsy6GfiJD9q7La4j)_

Fixes #32606

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach a declared override served at the package it declares and a tenant's edit following an item that moved between an App's packages (#31593); neither teaches a row declared for one package served at another, so no taught sentence moves.

> **BREAKING** (ADR-0087 `registered`, semantic entry `declared-row-not-moved-to-addition`): a bundle addition's address, list, execution list and customizations read no longer serve an App pair row declared for another package that still ships the name. Area-lease pilot #33059, area E1.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：App 的 `.custom` 存了一行邮件模板 `fr-FR`，声明覆盖模块 X（X 只发 `en-US`），同一 App 的附加包 Z 发 `fr-FR`。以前 Z 的精确地址、Z 的列表、发给 Z 的执行列表都把这行当成 Z 自己的条目给出（盖着 Z 的戳，校验 invalid）；现在 Z 只给自己的 `fr-FR`，这行只在 X 的地址给出。
- 为什么改：“迁移后编辑”规则（#31593）按成员粒度问“X 还发不发这个条目”，X 不发 `fr-FR` 就被当成已迁走；但 X 仍发这个名字，所以这行仍是 X 的。一行同时出现在两个包的地址上，违反专题红线 2。
- 风险与回滚：只影响“App pair 行声明的包仍发该名字的其他成员、另一个附加包发这一成员”这种罕见组合；X 什么都不再发时，编辑照旧跟随到 Z（对照测试已固定）。回滚即还原本 PR，存储数据不变。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/suite-moved-overlay.ts`（`ShipsName` 两个粒度，前任所有者按名字问），然后 `protocol-overlay-merge.ts` 列表合并里名字粒度的取法。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t 32606`，4 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

The moved-edit rule (#31593, `suite-moved-overlay.ts`) serves a row that declares, or is bound to, a former owner of an item at the package that ships the item now. It is meant to fire only when the former owner "no longer ships the name" (its own module header). Every caller built its `ShipsName` reading at the **member** grain (`shippedArtifactsOf(type, name, undefined, member)`; the list merge from the slot's own contributions), so for a bundle the former owner X, which ships `en-US`, read as not shipping `fr-FR`, and a bundle addition Z that ships `fr-FR` took X's declared row as its own moved edit.

- `ShipsName` is now two readings: `item` (the address's package ships the item at its member, as before) and `name` (the former owner ships any member of the name). `isMovedOverrideRowOf` / `isMovedBaseRowOf` ask `ships.item(base)` and `ships.name(former)`.
- The three callers fill both: `findServedOverlayRow` (`protocol-environment-rows.ts`) and `listServedOverrides` (`protocol-served-overrides.ts`) read `shippedArtifactsOf(type, name)` for the name; the list merge (`mergePackageAwareOverlay`) reads every slot of the name among its own base items, plus the caller's `shipsName` reading of the registry (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`), because a list scoped to Z draws its base items from Z alone.
- For a type that is not a bundle the two readings answer alike, so nothing else moves.
- Semantic entry `declared-row-not-moved-to-addition` (ADR-0087) and two changesets.

## Moved answers (both registration orders; measured on `main` e540baf8 first)

| read | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `?package=Z&member=fr-FR` | `pair fr-FR` (declared for X) stamped Z, `_diagnostics.valid: false` | `zeta fr-FR`, valid |
| Z's list | `['pair fr-FR']` | `['zeta fr-FR']` |
| Z's execution list (a send resolved to Z) | `['pair fr-FR']` | `['zeta fr-FR']` |
| `listServedOverrides({ packageId: Z })` | lists `welcome:fr-FR` | `[]` |
| registry `getPackageScopedItem(Z, fr-FR)` | `zeta fr-FR` | unchanged |
| X's address, X's list, X's execution list, `?package=A.custom` | `pair fr-FR` | unchanged |
| bare `?member=fr-FR` | 409 naming both | unchanged |

## Red lines

1. **Resolution never loosened.** Only Z's answers move, from a row declared for another package to Z's own item, which is what the registry already answered at Z. Nothing refused is now served.
2. **Ambiguity reported, never guessed.** One row is no longer served at two packages' addresses. The bare read keeps its 409.
3. **Independently releasable.** No stored row changes shape; #31593's moves still follow when the former owner ships nothing of the name (`[#32606] CONTROL — X ships nothing of the name`, both orders), and the runtime `meta-overlay-follows-suite.test.ts` (flat → composed, composed → flat, still-shipping CONTROL) stays green.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, in the #32561 block that already holds this exact arrangement:

- `[#32606] NARROWING — a row declared for X is never served at an addition Z that ships its locale` (addition installed first / row stored first): Z's address, list, execution list and customizations read answer Z's own; X's address, lists and customizations read keep the row.
- `[#32606] CONTROL — X ships nothing of the name: the row declaring X is the moved edit, served at Z` (both orders, UNCHANGED).

Ablations (source mutated, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` rebuilt, mutation seen in `dist/`, restored and rebuilt after, tree clean):

| | mutation | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `ships.name(former)` → `ships.item(former)` in both predicates | 2 failed (both NARROWING pins, at Z's address); both CONTROLs green |
| A2 | the list's registry `shipsName` reading forced `false` | 2 failed (`Z's list: expected [ 'pair fr-FR' ] to deeply equal [ 'zeta fr-FR' ]`); both CONTROLs green |

## Acceptance notes

- #32849 is **not** folded: measured on this branch, with the pair row declaring Z for Z's own `fr-FR`, `?package=Z` and Z's lists serve the override, but the bare `?member=fr-FR` read still serves `zeta fr-FR`. That is the bare read's path (`protocol-meta-item-face.ts`), a different function; it follows in its own PR.
- `listServedOverrides` was not named by the card; it reads the same candidates, so the same row was listed under Z. Fixed and pinned here.

## Verification

Local, on head `520a7445` (fix commits `2b2e5b41` + `520a7445`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` — 22843 passed, 43 skipped; `typecheck` 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` — 12940 passed (includes the four `[#32606]` pins, both hydration orders); `typecheck` 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-overlay-follows-suite.test.ts` — 12 passed (the #31593 moved-edit rule is unchanged where the former owner ships nothing of the name).
- Ablations: A1 (`ships.name(former)` → `ships.item(former)`) fails both NARROWING pins, CONTROLs green; A2 (the list's `shipsName` forced false) fails both on `Z's list: expected ['pair fr-FR'] to deeply equal ['zeta fr-FR']`. Both restored.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` — 89/89 derived gates exit 0 (8 re-run after a whole-tree `pnpm turbo run build`), incl. `check-adr-0087-registration`.
- CI on `520a7445`: 56 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed. The first head's Test Core 7/8 failure (`migrate-meta-engine-guidance`: the entry's printed reason cited a tracker id) is fixed by `520a7445`.
- `@objectstack/dogfood` test: running at the time of this edit; result follows in a comment.
